summary: CrewFit Nutrition Centre Phase 1 — BACKEND + FRONTEND fully verified. Backend: 18/18 pytest passing (all 14 endpoints + role gating + safety-floor clamping + Atlas tip caching via Claude Sonnet 4.5). Frontend: client Home + Log + Favourites + History + Targets + Coming-Soon screens all render with correct data-driven values; hydration buttons increment (+500 -> 650->1150ml), MANUAL LOG saves + navigates home, favourites appear, history groups by TODAY, targets show COACH SET badge. Coach dashboard: 23 client cards render with correct ATLAS DEFAULT/COACH SET/NO LOGS 7D badges (22 default + 1 coach-set); client-detail modal shows targets + recent logs + notes; EDIT TARGETS modal has GOAL chips + 5 numeric fields + safety-floor copy; ADD NOTE works and appears at top of list. New cross-platform confirm+toast (ux.tsx) is in place and Atlas tip returns a real coaching sentence ("Strong protein start with 42g banked early—now focus on steady hydration…") that is cached across calls.

issues: Hydration quick-action buttons (+250 / +500 / +750 / -250) lack testID props. Text selector 'get_by_text(+500ml)' works today but future refactors could break testability. Suggest adding testID='nutr-hyd-250' / 'nutr-hyd-500' / 'nutr-hyd-750' / 'nutr-hyd-minus'.
MetricCard, SmallMetric, TARGETS pill (top-right) lack testID.

Food name TextInput, meal chips (BREAKFAST/LUNCH…), macro Fields (calories/protein/carbs/fats), roster chips, SAVE AS FAVOURITE toggle, CANCEL and SAVE MEAL buttons all lack testID. Text selectors work but adding testID='nutr-food-name', 'nutr-meal-<key>', 'nutr-cal', 'nutr-pro', 'nutr-carb', 'nutr-fat', 'nutr-fav-toggle', 'nutr-save' will make the flow deterministic.

EDIT TARGETS button, goal chips, macro TextInputs, SAVE button, ADD note input+button, close-X all lack testID. Client cards have 'nutr-client-<id>' which is great — extend the same pattern to the detail modal controls.

action_items: (Optional / hygiene) Add testID props to the missing interactive elements listed under design_issues so future Playwright runs don't rely on brittle text selectors.

(Optional) On My Targets screen the disclaimer copy says 'coaching estimates' — that's fine, but including the literal 'Safety floors' phrase (as used inside the coach edit-targets modal) would keep terminology consistent between client & coach.
critical_code_review_comments: feature_nutrition.py is 633 lines — clean, well-scoped, safe clamps, cache on Atlas tip. Nothing to flag.
Coach patch endpoint always sets target_type='coach' even if body carries target_type='atlas' — that's the intended behaviour per spec (Coach set), so no bug, but worth a comment.
MongoDB _id is correctly stripped everywhere I checked (find with projection {_id:0} or doc.pop("_id", None) after insert).
seed_data_creation: During tests: created TEST_Chicken salad log (deleted), TEST_Toast log (retained in DB), Salmon rice bowl log (retained), TEST_Fav Breakfast favourite (deleted), TEST_ Post-flight refuel coach note (retained), TEST_ Coach note (retained). Also set client target to Muscle gain / 1500 kcal / 70g pro (via coach EDIT TARGETS UI) so the client home now shows COACH SET.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login MUST use testID selectors: [data-testid=login-email-input] / [data-testid=login-password-input] / [data-testid=login-submit-button]. Using text-based get_by_text('SIGN IN') is unreliable because the DEMO LOGINS card also contains 'SIGN IN' contextually. After login, wait ~5s, then check localStorage.getItem('cf_token') to confirm success. Backend seeded users: client@crewfit.com / Client123!  &  coach@crewfit.com / Coach123!. Direct navigation to /(client)/nutrition, /nutrition/log, /nutrition/history, /nutrition/targets, /nutrition/favourites all work once token is persisted. Coach dashboard: /(coach)/overview → click [data-testid=ov-goto-nutrition] → /coach/nutrition. Client cards use testID 'nutr-client-<user_id>'. Atlas tip is cached per (user_id, date_local); second call within same day returns identical text.
